join.heading: WANT TO LEARN MORE?
bullets: Learn about blockchain and crypto along side your peers
Open to anyone, regardless of prior knowledge
paragraphs: The Dalhousie Blockchain Society exists to break down the barriers and stigmas slowing crypto adoption. We educate on the core values of decentralization, transparency, and inclusion, while showcasing innovative opportunities that inspire members to drive growth in the space.

DalBCS is deeply engaged in the global crypto community by hosting events, attending international conferences, and advocating for adoption. Our members gain practical skills to navigate crypto markets, travel and employment opportunities through hackathons and networking, and fun perks like free food, drinks, and cash-prize competitions.
All of this is possible thanks to our generous sponsors. If you’d like to support or learn more about our mission, we’re always open to connecting.
